name: Silly Swingin Siamangs
summary: you're a siamang in a competitive game of bomb tag. You can find a lot of places to explore! Use the environment to your advantage to escape and give off the bomb! You can even put on stylish cosmetics to make yourself look like a professional model! With over 5 maps, 10 cosmetics. and a bomb tag gamemode, this game brings great fun too a competitive  VR game!
